posts.Title: Project Start
posts.Situation:
We have started a new project for the university course (CI6002_A_TB1_25) assigment. Assigment was expecting teams of games programming students and Media students. Team was created with 1 games and 2 media students.

We have make sure that we have group chat on discord.

We didn't have much of a idea of what to make.
posts.Task: Find a idea of what to make.
posts.Action: I have suggested that we will work on ideas speratly until another meeting next week and on the meeting we will decide on whose has best idea for the project. So I worked on game ideas and other made story ideas.
posts.Result:
I have created few game ideas. 2 game ideas which will drive the game and 4 minor game ideas which potencially be put into Story driven game.

Media student has come up with one story for 2D Grid Based Escape/Puzzle Room(s) major game idea after I shared my ideas on discord.

We have decided to make 2D Grid Based Escape/Puzzle Room(s) game and make some clarifications and corrections about the story.

Here are my game ideas:

gamesForGaMP.md

Games For Game and Media Project

Major Game Ideas

2D Grid Based Escape/Puzzle Room(s)

The Game Idea

It is a 2D grid based game where player is trapped in small location and must solve puzzles to get out.

Examples of simular ideas:

  • Escape Room Simulator
  • The room 2 and 3
  • Animal Well

Optionally we can make fail condition or/and results like in:

  • Keep talking and nobody explodes
  • Henry Stickmin game series

Story Compatibility

The story can be integrated with the gameplay.

Potencial integrated story hooks:

  • why is the player trapped
  • strong enviermental story telling
  • possible interactions with NPCs with possible gameplay effect (like external communication with info, villain working against you or another victim who can help with some things)

There is alternative endings potencial via escape method or/and actions within the location.

Art and Design

Having a small location reduces the scope and allows to pack it to the brim with elements and leaves a lot space for human art and programmer art.

Most likely we would need to focus on puzzle and story design or go into comedy or both.

There are likely already made assets for the map.

Tools

Tools: Axmol(game engine) and other tools most likely including custom ones.

Pros:

  • It is C++
  • it offers high flexibility and control
  • It is activly maintained and developed
  • It is cross platform (win,linux,mobile and web)
  • it is light and fast
  • Active community
  • Big general C/C++ ecosystem
  • Dev in this team is good with C/C++ and complex systems
  • Some of the core elements (mainly grid and grid related elements) happen to overlap with elements of another project on the same game engine which I would need to make them anyway. This way I could save time by creating one element and using it for both projects and effectivly merging my time for it.

Cons:

  • It is C++
  • It doesn't have its own GUI
  • Dev in this team is still learning it but he must learn it anyway for the other project.
  • Small community
  • Small dedicated ecosystem
  • Dev in this team is the only dev in their group who chooses Axmol over Unity, Godot and Unreal.

Random quote about C and C++: “C makes it easy to shoot yourself in the foot; C++ makes it harder, but when you do it blows your whole leg off.” - Bjarne Stroustrup

Control room

The Game Idea

Player is locked into a single room full of controls. Each control does something.

Examples of simular ideas:

  • Please, Don't Touch Anything
  • Papers, Please
  • That's Not My Neighbor
  • Not For Broadcast
  • FNAF and Fan-FNAF Games

Story Compatibility

The story can be integrated with the gameplay or/and outcome.

Potencial integrated story hooks:

  • job/task/goal
  • environment
  • NPC interactions like boss, effected NPC by player choice

There is alternative endings potencial via player player choices.

Art and Design

Having a single room reduces the scope and allows to pack it to the brim with elements, controls and leaves a lot space for human art and programmer art but in limited space.

Most likely we would need to focus on game mechanics and story design.

Most of the assets would need to be made.

Tools

Tools: Unity

Pros:

  • It handles animations pretty well.
  • Good US and UX support
  • It handles a lot of things for us

Cons:

  • possibility of summoning animator spaghetti god
  • small chance for hard to catch bugs.
  • Unity version (Major Security issue was discovered and patched versions of unity is not on university computers)

Minor Game Ideas

Rubic's rotator puzzle: rotated edition

The Game Idea

This game is simular to rubics cube but reduced down to 2D. Additional elements can be added.

Examples of simular ideas:

  • the same puzzle as I showed in videa with unreal game

difficulty

It may easly fo into easy to actual rubic's cube difficulty. hitting the sweet middle spot might be tricky.

Tools

Tools: any engine, ldtk (tile editor) + scripts

Manual based puzzle game

The Game Idea

Player is working on a device/machine and player must read the manual to do something on the machine.

Examples of simular ideas:

  • Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
  • Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop

difficulty

Following the instructions. Slow readers must be taken into the account when setting the difficulty.

Tools

Tools: any engine, editor to make PDF or make documents.

Piccross minigame

The Game Idea

Drawing shape by knowing the lengths and count of each seqment per row and column. Additional a third state could be added.

Examples of simular ideas:

  • picross

difficulty

It might be bit chaotic but scale of the image can be set which is a major factor.

Tools

Tools: any engine, solver + pixelart with 2 or 3 colour pallete

Radar/scanner and choice

The Game Idea

Player would be presesnted with scenario where they got limited information and resources. Player must identify what radar/scanner is showing and take the right action. Their choice may impact the story.

difficulty

It might be tricky to get it right but it is possible.

Tools

Tools: any engine
